descriptionChirho: A noun (tsamid) denoting a bracelet or armlet, an ornamental band worn on the arm or wrist. Appears in both plural (Gen 24:22,30,47; Num 31:50; Ezek 16:11 — 'bracelets') and singular (2 Sam 1:10 — 'and a bracelet'). Multilingual evidence is consistent: eng 'bracelet(s)', spa 'brazalete(s)/pulsera', hin चूड़ियाँ/कड़ा, arb أَسَاوِرَ/سِلْسِلَةً, kor 팔찌, swa 'bangili/kikuku'. The singular vs. plural distinction is grammatical inflection, not a separate sense.
